blocks.text: The explanation about an angel stirring the water in verses 3b-4 is absent from important early witnesses and is widely regarded as a later addition intended to explain the sick man’s expectation in verse 7. Its textual status is therefore disputed, even though the man’s words about the troubled water remain part of the surrounding scene. The chapter then connects the Sabbath healing with Jesus’ claims about the Father’s work, the Son’s authority to give life and judge, and the witnesses supporting his claims. The statement that Jesus was “making himself equal with God” first reports his opponents’ inference; the following discourse develops the Son-Father relationship rather than leaving that statement isolated.
